purpose: Bind source-backed profession bodies and workflows to explicit UC stations, with artifact observations and scoped deterministic practice memory.

properties.operation: catalog, inspect, plan, run, verify, prepare-specialists
properties.crew_id: local persistent crew identifier; defaults to default
properties.work_type: software, web, 3d, animation, game, audio, document
properties.context: exact task context; experience does not transfer across different context
properties.steps: 1..32 explicit action stations; each may name profession_id, skill_id, dependencies and a REQUIRED judgment boundary
properties.run_id: idempotent job identifier; interrupted jobs hold instead of replaying uncertain writes

relationships: uses existing UC capability routing and stepwise plan validation
carries 18 pinned Profession Fabric bodies with original workflow cards
limitations: Professional Bodies remain EXPERIMENTAL. Consultation/handoff cards are not executed cognitive agents.

Automatic adapters cover text/JSON, basic projects, procedural GLB, supplied target evidence, bounded static clearance repair, generated material bundles, material/UV quality checks, native texture binding and exact preview rendering. Other actions hold for adapter work. Mesh stations add optional Blender UV/bake/target work and native deformation observations.
Supplied external target packets are contract-checked without execution credit; the separate Blender target adapter reruns the actual backend and retains bounded local observations.
Artifact checks do not prove visual quality, gameplay feel, semantic adequacy or professional acceptance.
Learning is scoped deterministic practice memory and learned preflight, not neural training or self-canonization.
A verified static clearance repair can retain a built-in parameterized procedure; reuse recalculates from new geometry and rechecks actual triangle clearance within the current movement limit.
Completed, failed and interrupted jobs stay inspectable. At 256 jobs, preserve the crew and choose a new identifier.
